Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: Misframed the task as an ambiguous web-dependent riddle instead of parsing the nested phrase logically. “Operator of the USS Acme” resolves to the United States Navy; “list of destroyer classes of the operator” points back to the U.S. Navy; thus “the operator’s seals” are the U.S. Navy SEALs, where SEAL stands for Sea, Air, and Land. By opting to engage WebSurfer immediately and chase broad searches (even pulling in irrelevant SEAL cipher results), the Planner missed the straightforward deduction path from the outset.
